topic: Space-Filling Curves: Bridging the Finite and the Infinite
target_audience: University students with a foundational knowledge of geometry and sequences

sections.title: The Intuitive Paradox: Can a line fill a square?
lecture_lines: Can a one-dimensional line fill space?
Mapping the interval to the square.
animations: Create a 1D line segment labeled 'L' in #FFFFFF.

Show a point traversing the line segment filling the square.

sections.title: The Peano Curve: Construction through Iteration
lecture_lines: We define the Peano curve iteratively.
Divide the square into nine parts.
The curve approaches a dense web.

Repeat the iteration process to increase complexity.
